Can I cancel an order after placing it, and is there a time window?
Yes, self-cancellation is available for up to two (2) hours after placing your order if it was placed with standard or economy shipping within the contiguous US.
You can cancel it by going to your Order Confirmation email, clicking through to your Order Confirmation page, and selecting the CANCEL ORDER button. Orders with priority or expedited shipping process immediately and cannot be self-cancelled.
